lede: The Ecology Commission is set to dig into a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered leaf blowers in Town by 2028 and all other combustion lawn equipment by 2030 — that's a real policy proposal with a real timeline, and Wednesday is the moment to pay attention. The county is also moving on an income-eligibility change at Pinion Park, dropping the threshold to 80% AMI, which quietly reshapes who can get a deed-restricted unit here. Elsewhere, the Housing Authority subcommittee takes up the Martin roof exception, and the Film Festival rolls in Friday.
